author: Matt Wolfe
description:
Is AI making us dumber? 

A study from MIT found that reliance on LLM might be like building up a tolerance to thinking. 

I started looking into this because I was honestly feeling those effects myself. Stuff that I had been using AI for, like coming up with new video ideas, all of a sudden started to feel harder to do without AI. 

So I did a deep dive into what the research and science ACTUALLY says about how AI is affecting our brains and productivity and shared it all in my latest YouTube video linked here.⁠

Let me know in the comments: have you been feeling a similar effect after using AI for a while?

#ai
title: Is AI Making Us Dumber?
